meta.title: Usage Board
meta.description: Besides the sidebar panel, a compact selected-provider usage strip under the composer shows the current model route’s quota ring and percentage, with a hover popover for every window, remaining amount and reset time; DeepSeek shows its balance and unsupported routes are labelled. The panel still shows DeepSeek, GLM Coding Plan, Kimi Code and OpenCode Go usage, quota and balance, plus the usage_query tool.
